ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 4% high-intensity (white) to 96% low-intensity (charcoal/black) pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark low-intensity surface. High-contrast white pixel clusters are localized at the terminal tips of both lobes. A singular, distinct high-intensity vertical stroke is visible approximately 5% lateral to the median notch on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel interior angle of approximately 52 degrees. Notch depth occupies roughly 20% of the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Multiple peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 10 pixels along the boundary. Right lobe distal edge exhibits larger, more irregular indentations compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve with convex outer lateral margins tapering to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity pixels (rosettes) at the distal tips of both lobes, particularly prominent on the extreme outer edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical white linear mark near the median notch. Faint, parallel diagonal grey-on-black linear disruptions visible on the lower-mid region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged segments and deep notches on the outer trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating significant physical trauma or wear relative to the more uniform left lobe edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely uniform dark pigmentation classification with minimal macro-level mottling.
